title: Why Your Deep Research Agent Fails? On Hallucination Evaluation in Full Research Trajectory

bias_targets.methodology: Tracking the 'Utilized Chunk Count' and 'Noise Scores' across different temporal stages (early, middle, late) of the research trajectory to measure the agent's disproportionate reliance on initially retrieved information over new evidence.

Comparing the average size of utilized semantic clusters versus ignored semantic clusters, and analyzing the correlation between information heterogeneity (total cluster count) and the rate of information neglect (Noise Score) to show a preference for redundant over novel insights.
